our_interpretation: A decade from the post date ends on December 25, 2032.
The ordinary reading is a broad shift in the field's main emphasis toward combining LLMs with other techniques. It does not require scaling to stop.

I read 'pure focus' as a characterization of the dominant emphasis, not a claim that every AI researcher exclusively pursued scaling.
